name: Wand of Binding

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Assisted Escape
powers.text: Reaction, 1 charge: Advantage on a save to avoid being Paralyzed or Restrained, or on a check to escape a grapple (used automatically).

summary: 7 charges: Hold Monster (5) or Hold Person (2) at DC 17; a charge gives Advantage against being held.
text: Holds 7 charges and recovers 1d6 + 1 of them each dawn. When you spend the last one, roll 1d20, and a 1 turns the wand to ash, destroying it. Spells: while you hold it, cast Hold Person (2 charges) or Hold Monster (5 charges) from it, save DC 17. Assisted Escape: while holding it, you can spend 1 charge as a Reaction to gain Advantage on a saving throw against becoming Paralyzed or Restrained, or spend 1 charge to gain Advantage on a check to escape a grapple.
